task_context.problem_statement: Billy made 49 sandwiches; Katelyn made 47 more than that. Chloe made a quarter of the amount that Katelyn made. How many sandwiches did they make in all?
task_context.reference_solution:
Katelyn made 49+47 = <<49+47=96>>96 sandwiches.
Chloe made 96/4 = <<96/4=24>>24 sandwiches.
Billy, Katelyn, and Chloe made 49+96+24 = <<49+96+24=169>>169 sandwiches in all.
#### 169
